sources.snippet: Real-time portrait sketch generation running fully on the LiteRT CompiledModel GPU. The U²-Net portrait model turns a face photo into a hand-drawn pencil line portrait — a fun creative / AR filter. ~12 ms/frame on a Pixel 8a.
